movie.title: The Hanged Woman
movie.overview: Rosa Martín, a singer-songwriter known as La Ahorcada, takes her own life in the garden of the man she loved, Fran, who treated her as nothing more than a sexual object. The ghost of La Ahorcada remains in Fran's mansion, refusing to be ignored and determined to teach him a lesson. Her obsession will end up turning the lives of Fran and his family into a living hell.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After singer-songwriter Rosa Martín takes her own life on the estate of her callous lover, her vengeful ghost haunts his mansion to inflict a relentless nightmare on him and his family.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Devastated after being reduced to a mere sexual object by the man she loved, singer-songwriter Rosa Martín, known as La Ahorcada, ends her life in Fran's garden. Rather than passing on, her restless spirit remains bound to his estate, determined to force him to face the consequences of his cruelty. As her haunting intensifies, Rosa's relentless presence targets not just Fran, but everyone close to him. Her vengeful obsession ultimately transforms the lives of Fran and his family into an inescapable living hell.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Rosa Martín, a gifted singer-songwriter who performs under the stage name La Ahorcada, endures profound emotional heartbreak over her affection for Fran. Despite her devotion, Fran callously treats Rosa as nothing more than a temporary sexual object, discarding her feelings without remorse. Driven to utter despair, Rosa tragically takes her own life within the garden of Fran's estate. However, her death marks only the beginning of a supernatural retribution, as her spirit remains bound to the mansion. Refusing to be ignored or forgotten, the ghost of La Ahorcada begins to manifest with unsettling and hostile intensity. She launches a chilling crusade to teach Fran an unforgettable lesson about mistreatment and emotional ruin. As the terrifying supernatural occurrences grow stronger, Fran's once-comfortable life begins to unravel. The spirit's malice eventually expands beyond Fran, ensnaring his innocent family members in her path of vengeance. Ultimately, Rosa's tragic obsession turns the grand mansion into a claustrophobic nightmare, plunging Fran and his loved ones into a chilling fight for psychological and physical survival.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Hanged Woman is a haunting horror-drama centered on Rosa Martín, a talented singer-songwriter known as La Ahorcada. After enduring profound heartache from Fran—a man who objectifies her and dismisses her worth—Rosa takes her own life on the grounds of his lavish estate. Bound to the physical realm by her tragic end and a refusal to be cast aside, Rosa's spirit remains trapped within Fran's mansion. Driven by a vengeful desire to teach her former lover a lesson, her ghost initiates a terrifying campaign of haunting that targets Fran and his family, turning their comfortable existence into a living hell.

story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of the climax unfolds, revealing the lasting effects of La Ahorcada's haunting on Fran and his family, and the ultimate fate of her restless spirit.
story_structure.introduction: The tragic end of La Ahorcada, a talented singer, sets the stage for a haunting tale within the mansion of her former lover.
story_structure.risingAction: La Ahorcada's ghostly manifestations intensify, slowly chipping away at Fran's peace and impacting the lives of his family. Her presence becomes increasingly undeniable and disruptive.
